changes.title: Work through BACKLOG.md
changes.intent:
Work through BACKLOG.md
Pick ONE task from BACKLOG.md that is not on main yet and that no other agent is doing. Do only that task, with its tests, keep `node --test` green, commit, push with `forq push`, then run `forq status pushed "<task id>: <title>"` and stop. You will be told when it has landed; then you take the next one. If no task is left, reply "done".

Asked: Work through BACKLOG.md: give every coder the whole list and let each coder pick its own next task.

How to work: start exactly 6 agents now, all with the same task text:
"Work through BACKLOG.md
Pick ONE task from BACKLOG.md that is not on main yet and that no other agent is doing. Do only that task, with its tests, keep `node --test` green, commit, push with `forq push`, then run `forq status pushed "<task id>: <title>"` and stop. You will be told when it has landed; then you take the next one. If no task is left, reply "done"."
Never assign, split or dedupe the tasks yourself: each agent picks its own. Do not start more agents later.
Before you start them, run `forq dedupe BACKLOG.md` once (the board's dedupe pass; its pairs are shown to every agent).
The project's checks: node --test. Do not merge anything yourself.
